setting.title: The Recipe Tin
setting.premise: Hattie Lund invited five guests to Pine Hollow for a long weekend and a friendly bake-off on Saturday. On Saturday morning her late grandmother's recipe tin, a dented tin of handwritten index cards, is gone from the great room mantel, and the bake-off is put off until Monday.

timeline.text: Dessert in the great room. Hattie reads a few of Nana Ingrid's cards aloud and promises to open the bake-off with the plum kuchen card. Colette goes pale; Nell notices. The tin goes on the mantel.
Walt turns in, in the little room off the great room.
Colette and Pip walk out to the bunkhouse. Pip puts on her headphones and is asleep by midnight.
Hattie banks the fire, says goodnight to the tin on the mantel and goes up to bed.
Theo goes upstairs. Nell is still up in her room editing photos.
Theo creeps down to the kitchen to practice his pie crust in secret. Walt hears the pans; Nell hears Theo's door.
Theo gives up and dumps his third ruined crust in the compost bin beside the woodshed.
Theo walks past the mantel, where the tin still sits, and goes up to bed.
Colette slips into the lodge by the back door, lighting her way with her phone.
Colette lifts the tin from the mantel. Walt, awake with his knees, sees a small light cross toward the back door and takes it for Theo.
Colette buries the tin in the woodshed kindling bin. She can't bring herself to burn Ingrid's card, and there was no time to find it in the dark.
Colette is back in the bunkhouse. Pip sleeps through it.
During practice baking, Nell knocks Hattie's milk-glass cake stand off the counter and hides the pieces in her tote.
Bonfire by the lake. Theo leaves his red scarf on the bench.
Colette carries Theo's scarf back and hangs it on the bunkhouse coat hook.
On the bunkhouse porch, Colette asks Pip to say she saw her come back with warm milk on Friday, "so Hattie can stop fretting". Walt hears two women talking low.
Nell carries the cake stand pieces out to the woodshed and hides them under the tarp. Hattie sees her light from an upstairs window.
Sunday dinner. Theo, scarfless, grumbles that he has lost it. Pip sees it on the bunkhouse hook at nine.
Colette says goodnight.
Theo sneaks back to the kitchen for one last try at pie crust.
Colette takes the scarf off the hook, digs the tin out of the kindling, pockets the plum kuchen card, wraps the tin in Theo's scarf and leaves it on the chopping block.
Walt goes out to split kindling and finds the tin on the chopping block. Every card is there but one.

guests.name: Hattie Lund
guests.role: Your host, and Nana Ingrid's granddaughter
guests.voice: Warm and flustered. Long run-on sentences with "oh gosh" and trailing ellipses, doubles her exclamation marks when upset, the odd 💛.

guests.name: Walt Kessler
